text: So stock six carps that feed in different places. Silver carp at the surface eats phytoplankton; catla, also near the surface, eats zooplankton. Rohu feeds in the column. Grass carp eats the weeds at the margins. Mrigal and common carp work the bottom. The same pond feeds them all, and the yield jumps.
